proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b P
  rw [convexHull_insert (Set.insert_nonempty a {b}), convexHull_pair, mem_convexJoin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, q, ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩, u, v, hu, hv, huv, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst hz
    refine ⟨v * α, v * β, by positivity, by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : v * α + v * β = v := by rw [← mul_add, hαβ, mul_one]
      linarith
    · simp only [smul_zero, zero_add, smul_add, smul_smul]
  · rintro ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, rfl⟩
    by_cases h0 : s + t = 0
    · have hs0 : s = 0 := by linarith
      have ht0 : t = 0 := by linarith
      refine ⟨0, by simp, a, left_mem_segment ℝ a b, ?_⟩
      simp [hs0, ht0, left_mem_segment]
    · have hpos : 0 < s + t := lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm h0)
      refine ⟨0, by simp, (s / (s + t)) • a + (t / (s + t)) • b, ⟨s / (s + t), t / (s + t), by positivity, by positivity, by field_simp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨1 - (s + t), s + t, by linarith, hpos.le, by ring, ?_⟩
      simp only [smul_zero, zero_add, smul_add, smul_smul]
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h0, mul_div_cancel₀ _ h0]
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b P : V), P ∈ convexHull ℝ ({0, a, b} : Set V) ↔ ∃ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ 0 ≤ t ∧ s + t ≤ 1 ∧ P = s • a + t • b
